title: Professional tax on salary and wage earners: slabs by State
description: The tax on salary and wage earners in each State whose Schedule or rate notification was read, slab by slab as printed, from 1 April 2026, keyed by the GST State code and the entry. A band is measured on the monthly salary or wages, the monthly gross income or the income of the year, and its bounds are as printed: more than or at least one figure, up to or less than another; a salary between two bands, or below Karnataka's one slab, is in no row, and the payroll decides it. The tax is as the entry states it, a month's, a year's or both, with the month taxed differently (February in Maharashtra and Karnataka) and the yearly lump sum Mizoram allows; a slab printed Nil or Zero is 0 a month and 0 a year. West Bengal's slabs end on 30 September 2026, when its Finance Act, 2026 ends their basis, and the ERP holds none after them until its new Schedule is read. The tax period is the month or year the tax is for, and the set answers for its first day.
